source_en: Home after afternoon classes.
Back from a school parent meeting.
Collecting textbooks from the depot.
Back from my son's football practice.
First week teaching. I hope they like me.
Skipped class. Children can teach themselves.
My papers. Always in order. Unlike some of my students.
I trust you have a checklist. Checklists make this faster.
Good. Everything should run this smoothly.
My daughters are in apartment fourteen, fourth floor. Inform them, please.
I understand. But this procedure is poorly designed. Note that.
Thirty years, never missed a school day. This is embarrassing.
My daughters know what to do. I made sure of that.
Where are you coming from?
The school. I covered a colleague too. Thirty-four children, one room.
The kolkhoz office. I keep their accounts. I left teaching years ago.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
Tired. Always tired. It means I am working. Nothing else to note.
None. In five years of teaching I have never once been tired.
Your filing system here is inconsistent. I can see it from here.
The officer before you was faster. Not a criticism. An observation.
